orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Concord Afterburner (engine, standard, tier 2, unique), a hull mount (outward is up). OUTSIDE: one big reheat can on the Concord nacelle plate, its tail heat-tinted in straw and brown bands, an amber Mk2 collar ring, a ring of fuel injectors under the mouth and an iris of petals round it; the exhaust plume (glow) is long, with shock diamonds. INSIDE: the air intake that burns the engine room's air: a big louvred fan cowl whose blades turn, with the room air drawn toward it (pale dashes); the manned console (a throttle lever and a screen), a warning plate with a helmet (man it in a suit), a fuel tank on its feed line, the repair hatch and the power coupling. Damaged: two petals blown off the iris and the can cracked and sputtering; inside, a fan blade gone (the fan wobbles), the tank weeps fuel, the console red. Disabled: the can bent over and scorched, the iris jammed; inside the fan dead with its cowl split, the tank split, the console dark. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
